epic.summary: Upgrade charge-controller firmware from Zephyr v3.2 to v4.3

tickets.title: Foundation: Zephyr v4.3 workspace, Kconfig, test harness, reference board
acceptance: west.yml tracks zephyrproject-rtos v4.3-branch; `make test` runs on native_sim
All existing unit tests pass on Zephyr v4.3 (none removed, none skipped)
Reference board mppt_2420_lc builds under hardware model v2 inside the flash budget
Board and devicetree roots are declared in zephyr/module.yml
tickets.description:
## Scope
Wave 0 of the Zephyr v3.2 -> v4.3 upgrade. Base branch: `upgrade/zephyr-4.3`.

## Owned paths
- `west.yml`
- `zephyr/**`
- `app/CMakeLists.txt`
- `app/prj.conf`
- `app/Kconfig`
- `tests/**`
- `boards/*/mppt_2420_lc/**`
- `dts/**`
- `scripts/**`
- `.github/**`

## Findings (48)
- API-MAIN-001: main() must return int (1)
- BOARD-001: Board uses hardware model v1 layout (boards/<arch>/) (1)
- BOARD-002: Board defconfig selects the SoC (now derived from board.yml) (2)
- BOARD-003: config BOARD default set in Kconfig.defconfig (1)
- BUILD-001: BOARD_ROOT / DTS_ROOT set from the application CMakeLists (4)
- BUILD-BOARD-MODEL: Board not found by the hardware model v2 loader (1)
- BUILD-KCONFIG: Kconfig symbol no longer exists: CPLUSPLUS (1)
- BUILD-KCONFIG: Kconfig symbol no longer exists: LIB_CPLUSPLUS (1)
- DT-CAN-001: CAN bus-speed / sjw / sample-point devicetree properties (1)
- KCFG-001: CONFIG_CPLUSPLUS removed (use CONFIG_CPP) (2)
- KCFG-002: CONFIG_LIB_CPLUSPLUS removed (use CONFIG_REQUIRES_FULL_LIBCPP) (2)
- KCFG-003: Newlib selected explicitly (picolibc is the default C library) (3)
- TEST-001: native_posix board removed (use native_sim) (26)
- WEST-001: Zephyr pinned to the v3.2 vendor fork (1)
- WEST-002: CMSIS module renamed (cmsis -> cmsis_6) (1)

## Acceptance criteria
- west.yml tracks zephyrproject-rtos v4.3-branch; `make test` runs on native_sim
- All existing unit tests pass on Zephyr v4.3 (none removed, none skipped)
- Reference board mppt_2420_lc builds under hardware model v2 inside the flash budget
- Board and devicetree roots are declared in zephyr/module.yml

## Gate
`python3 tools/migrate/gate.py --ticket foundation --boards mppt_2420_lc`

tickets.title: CAN boards: FDCAN devicetree and CAN / ISO-TP flags API
acceptance: mppt_2420_hc and mppt_2420_rc build under hardware model v2 with CAN enabled
CAN frames and filters use the flags API; ISO-TP uses fixed addressing flags
New unit tests pin the CAN identifier and filter-mask layout used on the bus
tickets.description:
## Scope
Wave 1 of the Zephyr v3.2 -> v4.3 upgrade. Base branch: `upgrade/zephyr-4.3`.

## Owned paths
- `boards/*/mppt_2420_hc/**`
- `boards/*/mppt_2420_rc/**`
- `app/src/ext/can.cpp`
- `app/src/ext/can_msg*`
- `tests/src/tests_can*`

## Findings (32)
- API-CAN-001: CAN frame / filter id_type and rtr fields (replaced by flags) (8)
- API-ISOTP-001: ISO-TP isotp_msg_id addressing bitfields (replaced by flags) (4)
- BOARD-001: Board uses hardware model v1 layout (boards/<arch>/) (2)
- BOARD-002: Board defconfig selects the SoC (now derived from board.yml) (4)
- BOARD-003: config BOARD default set in Kconfig.defconfig (2)
- BOARD-004: Board revisions declared in revision.cmake (1)
- DT-CAN-001: CAN bus-speed / sjw / sample-point devicetree properties (8)
- DT-CAN-002: STM32G4 CAN node label can1 (now fdcan1) (2)
- DT-LABEL-001: Devicetree label property on a device node (1)

## Acceptance criteria
- mppt_2420_hc and mppt_2420_rc build under hardware model v2 with CAN enabled
- CAN frames and filters use the flags API; ISO-TP uses fixed addressing flags
- New unit tests pin the CAN identifier and filter-mask layout used on the bus

## Gate
`python3 tools/migrate/gate.py --ticket can --boards mppt_2420_hc,mppt_2420_rc --base-ref origin/upgrade/zephyr-4.3`
